title: SOC ADFS · Servicios por minuto
description: Eventos ponderados por event_count. Los huecos no confirman disponibilidad. Para CSV histórico, seleccione sus fechas originales.

list.name: service
list.label: Servicio
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service AS __text, service AS __value FROM soc_service_minute_dashboard WHERE $__timeFilter(minute_utc) AND source_name = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT minute_utc AS time, service AS metric, SUM(total_events)::double precision AS value FROM soc_service_minute_dashboard WHERE $__timeFilter(minute_utc) AND source_name = ${source:sqlstring} AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT minute_utc AS time, SUM(success_count)::double precision AS "Éxitos", SUM(failure_count)::double precision AS "Fallos", SUM(lockout_count)::double precision AS "Bloqueos" FROM soc_service_minute_dashboard WHERE $__timeFilter(minute_utc) AND source_name = ${source:sqlstring} AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT minute_utc AS time, 100.0 * SUM(failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(total_events),0) AS "Fallos (%)" FROM soc_service_minute_dashboard WHERE $__timeFilter(minute_utc) AND source_name = ${source:sqlstring} AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT service AS "Servicio", SUM(total_events) AS "Autenticaciones", SUM(failure_count) AS "Fallos", SUM(lockout_count) AS "Bloqueos", MAX(minute_utc) AS "Último evento", MAX(updated_at_utc) AS "Última ingesta" FROM soc_service_minute_dashboard WHERE $__timeFilter(minute_utc) AND source_name = ${source:sqlstring} AND service IN (${service:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 100
